title: No .env file is tracked in git
remediation: git rm --cached <file>; add `.env` and `.env.*` (except `.env.example`) to .gitignore; rotate every value the file held.

title: No service-account key, PEM or P12 file is tracked
remediation: Remove from the tree, rotate the credential at the provider, and move CI to workload identity (OIDC).

title: A .gitignore exists
remediation: Create .gitignore covering env files, key files, build output and emulator exports.

title: No placeholder secrets or test identities in source
remediation: Classify each hit as guarded (emulator/test only) or unguarded; source unguarded values from the environment and fail closed when missing.

title: An env example file documents required variables
remediation: Add .env.example listing every variable name (no values).

title: A CI configuration exists
remediation: Add a check workflow that runs typecheck, lint, tests and build on every pull request.

title: A project contract or README exists
remediation: Add README.md (and AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md for agent sessions).

title: A rollback path is documented
remediation: Document the exact rollback commands (hosting rollback, redeploy of previous commit) in README or docs/.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-218 SSDF v1.1 — PS.3 archive and protect each release (practice id: model-prior; document existence sourced)

title: Runtime versions checked against the vendor's support page this session

check.prompt: Fetch the vendor runtime-support page now, record URL + HTTP status + the deprecation/decommission date for every runtime in the profile (node_version facet). Do not rely on a remembered table.

remediation: Upgrade any runtime past its deprecation date before deploying.

sources.title: Cloud Run functions runtime support (example of a dated table)

title: Authorization is enforced server-side on every privileged route

check.prompt: Open the server auth middleware and each admin/privileged route. Confirm role or permission checks run server-side, not only in UI or layout. Record file:line per route.

remediation: Add a server-side permission check to each privileged handler; add a test per route.

sources.title: Next.js production checklist — Server Actions: verify auth inside each action

title: Security response headers are configured

check.prompt: Locate where response headers are set (server, CDN, hosting config). Confirm HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and a CSP on authenticated surfaces.

remediation: HSTS max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload · nosniff · frame-ancestors 'none' · Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin · Permissions-Policy geolocation=(), camera=(), microphone=()

title: A deploy guard refuses demo targets, dirty trees and missing env
remediation: Add scripts/deploy-guard that exits non-zero on demo project ids, dirty tree, unpushed branch, missing build-time env.
